name: audit-entries-by-module
evidence: pkg_ow_util.log_msg (01_pkg_util.sql:70-71, ap-779ce5b5b7): autonomous-transaction writer called from every package entry point; entries per module with the logged span
source_sql: SELECT module AS "module", COUNT(*) AS "entries", MIN(logged_at) AS "firstLoggedAt", MAX(logged_at) AS "lastLoggedAt" FROM billing_audit_log GROUP BY module

name: audit-issued-invoice-entries
evidence: pkg_invoicing.sp_issue_invoice log line (04_pkg_invoicing.sql:192-193 via pkg_ow_util.log_msg): one 'issued invoice=' entry per issue; the loaded message text must survive verbatim
source_sql: SELECT log_id AS "logId", module AS "module", message AS "message" FROM billing_audit_log WHERE message LIKE 'issued invoice=%'
